description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **token** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
The IDs of the firewall templates.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查询可用地域。
description.en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the [ListRegions](~~189315~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: 删除防火墙模板不会影响已设置轻量应用服务器实例的防火墙规则，如果您不再需要防火墙模板，可以选择删除。
descriptions.en: Deleting a firewall template does not affect the firewall rules that have been applied to simple application servers. You can delete firewall templates that you no longer need.
